setup.en: Use a light straight bar with collars if plates are fitted. Choose a shoulder-width underhand grip; if the straight bar forces an uncomfortable wrist position, choose the dumbbell version.
setup.zh: 用较轻的直杠，装杠片时上好卡扣。采用与肩大致同宽的反握；直杠让手腕不舒服时，改用哑铃版本。

steps.en: Stand with feet comfortably apart and knees soft. Hold the bar in front of the thighs, palms forward, thumbs wrapped around it.
steps.zh: 双脚自然分开站稳，膝盖不硬锁。杠在大腿前，掌心向前，拇指扣住杠。

steps.en: Set the upper arms beside the ribs and keep the wrists in line with the forearms. Let the elbows approach straight without forcing them backward.
steps.zh: 上臂放在肋骨旁，腕与前臂成一线。肘接近伸直，但不要往后硬顶。

steps.en: Breathe out and bend the elbows to raise the bar towards the front of the shoulders, without lifting the elbows forward.
steps.zh: 呼气，屈肘把杠抬向肩前，上臂不要明显向前抬。

steps.en: Stop while the forearms can still support the bar and the shoulders stay quiet; do not press the bar into the chest.
steps.zh: 在前臂仍能承托杠、肩部保持安静的位置停下，不要把杠压进胸口。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower along the same path until the arms are nearly straight. After finishing, put the bar down under control.
steps.zh: 吸气，沿原路慢慢下放到手臂接近伸直。结束后有控制地放好杠。

cues.en: Keep the elbows near your sides.
cues.zh: 肘留在身体两侧。

cues.en: Feel the front upper arms work while the wrists stay quiet.
cues.zh: 上臂前面用力，手腕保持稳定。

cues.en: Expect muscular effort at the front of the upper arm and forearm, not joint pain.
cues.zh: 应感到上臂前面和前臂肌肉用力，不是关节疼痛。

mistakes.en: Rocking backward to start the curl. Why: trunk momentum moves the bar before the elbow flexors can control it.
mistakes.zh: 起杠时后仰。为什么：躯干的惯性先带动杠，屈肘肌难以控制动作。

mistakes.en: Bending the wrists under the bar. Why: it adds wrist motion instead of completing elbow flexion.
mistakes.zh: 杠下弯腕。为什么：多出来的是腕部动作，不是完成屈肘。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: Stop for sharp pain at the elbow or wrist; do not force a fixed grip.
cautions.zh: 肘或腕出现刺痛就停下，不要硬迁就固定握法。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Stand in a clear space with light dumbbells. This version starts palms inward and turns them upward as the elbows bend.
setup.zh: 在有余地的地方站立，用轻哑铃。这个版本从掌心相对开始，屈肘时逐渐把掌心转向上。

steps.en: Stand tall, feet planted, dumbbells beside the thighs, thumbs pointing forward and wrists straight.
steps.zh: 站直踩稳，哑铃在大腿两旁，拇指朝前，腕保持平直。

steps.en: Keep the upper arms close to the body and begin bending the elbows without swinging the weights.
steps.zh: 上臂靠近身体，开始屈肘，不甩动哑铃。

steps.en: As the weights rise, turn the forearms so the palms face upward. Keep the shoulder from rotating to fake the turn.
steps.zh: 重量上升时让前臂旋后，掌心转向上；不要转肩来假装完成这段转动。

steps.en: Finish with the dumbbells near the front of the shoulders. A small natural forward movement of the upper arm is acceptable; do not make it a front raise.
steps.zh: 哑铃到肩前附近时停下。上臂可自然稍向前移，但不要变成前平举。

steps.en: Lower slowly, reversing the forearm turn to return to palms inward. Put the dumbbells down without twisting the trunk.
steps.zh: 慢慢下放，同时反向转回掌心相对。放好哑铃，不扭转躯干。

cues.en: Turn the forearm, not the whole shoulder.
cues.zh: 转前臂，不是转整个肩。

cues.en: Let the wrist follow the forearm as a straight unit.
cues.zh: 腕与前臂保持一线，一起转动。

cues.en: Expect muscular effort at the front of the upper arm and forearm, not joint pain.
cues.zh: 应感到上臂前面和前臂肌肉用力，不是关节疼痛。

mistakes.en: Twisting only at the wrist. Why: supination is rotation of the radius relative to the ulna, not a wrist twist.
mistakes.zh: 只在手腕上拧。为什么：旋后是桡骨相对尺骨的转动，不是拧腕。

mistakes.en: Raising the elbows high to finish. Why: shoulder flexion replaces the last part of the curl.
mistakes.zh: 最后把肘抬得很高。为什么：肩前举替代了弯举的最后一段。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: Use a comfortable forearm turn; stop if the front of the elbow or shoulder hurts.
cautions.zh: 前臂只转到舒服的位置；肘前或肩前疼痛就停下。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Choose light dumbbells and a standing position. Keep the palms facing each other throughout.
setup.zh: 选轻哑铃，采用站姿，全程保持掌心相对。

steps.en: Stand with feet planted and dumbbells beside the thighs, thumbs pointing forward.
steps.zh: 站稳，哑铃在大腿两侧，拇指朝前。

steps.en: Bring the elbows beside the ribs and keep the wrists straight, like holding hammer handles.
steps.zh: 肘放在肋骨旁，腕保持平直，像握着锤柄。

steps.en: Breathe out and bend the elbows to raise the dumbbells towards the front of the shoulders, maintaining the neutral grip.
steps.zh: 呼气，屈肘把哑铃抬向肩前，维持对握。

steps.en: Pause before the elbows move forward or the weights touch the shoulders. Keep the chest and pelvis still.
steps.zh: 在肘开始前移、哑铃碰到肩之前停下，胸廓和骨盆保持稳定。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly to nearly straight elbows. Set the dumbbells down carefully when finished.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢下放到肘接近伸直；结束时平稳放好哑铃。

cues.en: Keep the thumbs up as the weights rise.
cues.zh: 上升时拇指朝上。

cues.en: Feel the front upper arm and outer forearm share the work.
cues.zh: 感受上臂前面和前臂外侧共同用力。

cues.en: Expect muscular effort at the front of the upper arm and forearm, not joint pain.
cues.zh: 应感到上臂前面和前臂肌肉用力，不是关节疼痛。

mistakes.en: Turning the palms up midway. Why: it changes this neutral-grip version into a supinating curl.
mistakes.zh: 做到一半把掌心转向上。为什么：这会把对握版本变成旋后弯举。

mistakes.en: Swinging the weights across the body. Why: momentum and shoulder motion replace controlled elbow flexion.
mistakes.zh: 把哑铃甩过身体中线。为什么：惯性和肩部动作替代了受控屈肘。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: Reduce the load if the wrist bends or grip becomes insecure.
cautions.zh: 腕开始弯曲或握不稳时，减轻重量。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a light bar and a comfortable overhand grip. Select a load you can move without bending the wrists or swinging.
setup.zh: 用轻杠和舒服的正握。选择能保持腕平直、不甩动身体的重量。

steps.en: Stand with the bar in front of the thighs, palms facing the thighs and thumbs wrapped around the bar.
steps.zh: 杠放在大腿前，掌心朝大腿，拇指扣住杠。

steps.en: Keep the upper arms beside the body, shoulders relaxed and wrists aligned with the forearms.
steps.zh: 上臂靠近身体，肩放松，腕与前臂成一线。

steps.en: Breathe out and bend the elbows to lift the bar, keeping the palms down as the forearms rise.
steps.zh: 呼气，屈肘抬杠，前臂上升时保持掌心向下。

steps.en: Stop at a height where the wrists remain straight and the elbows have not moved forward.
steps.zh: 在腕仍平直、肘没有前移的高度停下。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly to nearly straight arms; place the bar securely down after finishing.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢下放到手臂接近伸直；结束后稳妥放好杠。

cues.en: Lift with the elbow bend, not with a wrist flick.
cues.zh: 靠屈肘抬，不靠甩腕。

cues.en: Keep the bar secure in the whole hand.
cues.zh: 用整个手稳稳握住杠。

cues.en: Expect muscular effort at the front of the upper arm and forearm, not joint pain.
cues.zh: 应感到上臂前面和前臂肌肉用力，不是关节疼痛。

mistakes.en: Letting the wrists fold down. Why: the wrist support fails while the elbow movement continues.
mistakes.zh: 腕向下折。为什么：肘还在动，腕却已经失去支撑。

mistakes.en: Using the same load as a comfortable palm-up curl. Why: a grip change can exceed the control available in this version.
mistakes.zh: 照搬反握弯举的重量。为什么：换握法后，这个重量可能超过你当前能控制的范围。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: Choose a dumbbell neutral grip if the fixed overhand grip is uncomfortable.
cautions.zh: 固定正握不舒服时，改用哑铃对握。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a secure overhead bar and a stable step for getting on and off. Begin with foot support or suitable assistance if you cannot control both the rise and lowering.
setup.zh: 用安装牢固的单杠，并准备稳固踏台上下。无法控制上拉和下放时，先用脚部支撑或合适的辅助。

steps.en: From the step, grasp the bar shoulder-width with palms facing you and thumbs wrapped around it.
steps.zh: 从踏台握杠，反握、掌心朝向自己，握距与肩大致同宽，拇指扣杠。

steps.en: Take your weight gradually, arms nearly straight overhead, shoulders comfortable and trunk steady; do not drop suddenly into a hang.
steps.zh: 逐渐把体重交给双手，手臂在头顶接近伸直，肩部舒服、躯干稳定，不要突然落入悬垂。

steps.en: Breathe out and draw the upper arms down while bending the elbows. Let the shoulder blades move naturally without kicking the legs.
steps.zh: 呼气，一边把上臂往下带，一边屈肘；肩胛骨自然运动，不踢腿借力。

steps.en: Rise as far as you can without craning the neck; aim for the chin to clear the bar only if you can keep the same control.
steps.zh: 上升到不用仰头探下巴的高度；只有仍能稳定控制时，才让下巴超过杠。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly to the comfortable starting reach. Use the step to unload the hands before releasing the bar.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢下放回舒服的起始伸展位置。脚踩踏台卸掉手上的重量，再松手。

cues.en: Bring the elbows down, rather than reaching with the chin.
cues.zh: 把肘往下拉，不用下巴去够杠。

cues.en: Feel the back and front arms working together.
cues.zh: 感受背部和上臂前面共同用力。

cues.en: Expect muscular effort at the front of the upper arm and forearm, not joint pain.
cues.zh: 应感到上臂前面和前臂肌肉用力，不是关节疼痛。

mistakes.en: Kicking or swinging to get above the bar. Why: momentum hides whether you can control the pulling range.
mistakes.zh: 踢腿或摆荡上杠。为什么：惯性掩盖了你是否能控制这段上拉。

mistakes.en: Dropping from the top. Why: you lose control as the shoulder and elbow return to a lengthened position.
mistakes.zh: 到顶后直接掉下来。为什么：肩和肘回到伸展位置时，你已经失去控制。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: The moving model shows a shortened shoulder-and-elbow sequence. It does not depict a suspended body or contact with a fixed bar; use the sketch and steps for the real exercise.
cautions.zh: 动态模型只展示缩小幅度的肩肘动作，不表现身体悬垂或握住固定单杠；真实动作请参照示意图和步骤。

cautions.en: Use assistance rather than forcing a painful hang; stop for shoulder pain, elbow pain or hand numbness.
cautions.zh: 不要硬撑疼痛的悬垂，改用辅助；肩痛、肘痛或手麻就停下。

cautions.en: This is a back-and-arm compound pull; latissimus dorsi is a prime mover, not an arm-only exercise.
cautions.zh: 这是背部与手臂共同完成的复合拉；背阔肌是主动肌之一，不是只靠手臂。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a flat bench in a rack with safety bars just below the intended bottom position, or a trained spotter. Use a roughly shoulder-width grip, not hands touching.
setup.zh: 用架内平板凳，保护杠略低于预定最低点，或请懂得保护的人协助。握距约与肩同宽，不把两手挤在一起。

steps.en: Lie with head, upper back and buttocks supported and feet flat. Gently draw the shoulder blades back.
steps.zh: 躺下，头、上背和臀部有支撑，双脚踩平，肩胛骨轻轻后收。

steps.en: Take a shoulder-width overhand grip with thumbs around the bar. Keep the bar over the heel of the palm and wrists nearly straight.
steps.zh: 正握，握距与肩大致同宽，拇指扣杠；杠压在掌根上，腕尽量平直。

steps.en: Unrack and settle the bar above the shoulders with arms nearly straight.
steps.zh: 取杠，稳稳停在肩上方，手臂接近伸直。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly towards the lower chest, keeping the elbows closer to the ribs than in a wider-grip press and the forearms near vertical.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢放向胸部下方；与宽握相比，肘更靠近肋骨，前臂尽量竖直。

steps.en: Breathe out and press up and slightly back. Finish smoothly without lifting the hips or snapping the elbows.
steps.zh: 呼气，向上、稍向后推；平稳结束，不抬臀、不猛顶肘。

steps.en: Move the bar back against the uprights and settle it onto both hooks before opening the hands.
steps.zh: 把杠移回并贴住立柱，确认落在两边挂钩上再松手。

cues.en: Keep the wrists over the elbows under the load.
cues.zh: 受力时腕叠在肘上方。

cues.en: The chest still helps; feel the backs of the arms extend the elbows.
cues.zh: 胸肌仍参与；感受上臂后面使肘伸直。

cues.en: Expect effort in the back of the upper arm, not joint pain.
cues.zh: 应感到上臂后面用力，不是关节疼痛。

mistakes.en: Putting the hands almost together. Why: an extremely narrow grip can force the wrists out of line.
mistakes.zh: 两手几乎挤在一起。为什么：过窄会让腕偏离受力方向。

mistakes.en: Bouncing off the chest. Why: the rebound replaces control at the bottom of the press.
mistakes.zh: 砸胸反弹。为什么：最低点的控制被反弹替代。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: Use safety bars or a competent spotter; stop for sharp shoulder, chest or elbow pain.
cautions.zh: 用保护杠或合格保护者；肩、胸或肘刺痛就停下。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Attach a straight handle to a high pulley and select a light load. Check the pin and connector before starting.
setup.zh: 高位滑轮装直杆，选轻配重；开始前检查插销和连接扣。

steps.en: Face the station, stand steadily and take a closed overhand grip that keeps the forearms parallel.
steps.zh: 面对器械站稳，正握扣住把手，握距让两侧前臂大致平行。

steps.en: Bring the elbows beside the ribs. Keep the torso upright, shoulders quiet and wrists straight.
steps.zh: 肘留在肋骨旁，躯干直立，肩安静，腕平直。

steps.en: Exhale and extend the elbows, pressing the handle down without moving the upper arms.
steps.zh: 呼气，伸肘压下把手，上臂不移动。

steps.en: Finish smoothly near straight elbows. Do not snap them or lean onto the handle.
steps.zh: 肘接近伸直时平稳停下，不猛顶，不把体重压在把手上。

steps.en: Inhale and return slowly to the starting bend. Let the stack settle before releasing the handle.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢回到起始屈肘位置；结束时让配重回位再松手。

cues.en: Only the forearms swing; the upper arms stay quiet.
cues.zh: 前臂转动，上臂保持稳定。

cues.en: Let the weights return quietly.
cues.zh: 配重轻轻回落。

cues.en: Expect effort in the back of the upper arm, not joint pain.
cues.zh: 应感到上臂后面用力，不是关节疼痛。

mistakes.en: Leaning the whole body onto the handle. Why: bodyweight replaces elbow-extension effort.
mistakes.zh: 整个人压在把手上。为什么：体重替代了伸肘用力。

mistakes.en: Letting the elbows travel backward during the push. Why: shoulder extension adds a different movement.
mistakes.zh: 下压时肘向后跑。为什么：加入了肩后伸，动作不再只是伸肘。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: Keep fingers away from the stack and pulley; stop for elbow pain or tingling.
cautions.zh: 手指远离配重与滑轮；肘痛或麻刺就停下。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Sit on a stable bench with a near-upright backrest. Use a light dumbbell for a single-arm version; lift it to the shoulder with help from the other hand before raising it overhead.
setup.zh: 坐在靠背接近直立的稳固凳上。用轻哑铃做单臂版本，另一只手帮助把哑铃送到肩部，再举过头顶。

steps.en: Plant the feet, sit against the backrest, and hold the dumbbell overhead with a neutral grip and elbow nearly straight.
steps.zh: 双脚踩稳，背靠凳面，对握把哑铃举到头顶，肘接近伸直。

steps.en: Set the upper arm in a comfortable overhead position. Keep the ribs over the pelvis rather than arching the low back.
steps.zh: 上臂放在舒服的过顶位置，肋骨叠在骨盆上方，不弓起下背。

steps.en: Breathe in and bend the elbow, lowering the dumbbell behind the head only as far as you can reverse smoothly. Keep it clear of the head.
steps.zh: 吸气，屈肘把哑铃放到头后；只下到能平稳推回的深度，哑铃与头保持距离。

steps.en: Breathe out and straighten the elbow while keeping the upper arm in place; do not force the last part of extension.
steps.zh: 呼气，伸肘，保持上臂位置，不硬顶最后一段。

steps.en: To finish, use the other hand to help bring the dumbbell to the shoulder and lap. Repeat on the other side with the same comfortable control.
steps.zh: 结束时用另一只手协助，把哑铃带回肩部和腿上；另一侧也保持同样舒服、受控的动作。

cues.en: Move at the elbow; keep the upper arm comfortably raised.
cues.zh: 肘动，上臂舒服地举着。

cues.en: Keep the ribs from lifting away from the pelvis.
cues.zh: 不要挺起肋骨、让它远离骨盆。

cues.en: Expect effort in the back of the upper arm, not joint pain.
cues.zh: 应感到上臂后面用力，不是关节疼痛。

mistakes.en: Arching the low back to reach overhead. Why: trunk extension substitutes for a shoulder position you cannot hold.
mistakes.zh: 为了举过头顶弓腰。为什么：躯干后伸代替了你不能维持的肩位。

mistakes.en: Dropping the dumbbell deeply behind the head. Why: momentum carries the elbow past a range you can control.
mistakes.zh: 把哑铃猛落到头后很深。为什么：惯性会把肘带过你能控制的幅度。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: The model demonstrates the working joint only; support and single-hand equipment contact are shown by the sketch and described in the steps.
cautions.zh: 模型只演示练习侧关节；支撑和单手器械接触由示意图与步骤说明。

cautions.en: The model uses a lower arm elevation to protect the mesh. The sketch shows the overhead position; do not copy the model angle as a required range.
cautions.zh: 为保护网格，模型上臂抬得较低；示意图展示过顶位置，不要把模型角度当成规定幅度。

cautions.en: Use the pushdown instead if overhead positioning is painful or requires back arching.
cautions.zh: 过顶位置疼痛或必须弓腰才能维持时，改用下压。

cautions.en: Keep a secure grip and avoid contact with the head; use help to position the dumbbell.
cautions.zh: 握牢，避免碰头；就位时用另一只手协助。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Sit beside a flat bench. Rest a forearm on the padded surface palm up, hand just beyond the edge, and use a very light dumbbell.
setup.zh: 坐在平板凳旁，前臂掌心向上放在软垫上，手刚好伸出边缘，用很轻的哑铃。

steps.en: Plant the feet and support the full forearm with the elbow comfortably bent; the other hand can help steady it.
steps.zh: 双脚踩稳，整个前臂有支撑，肘舒服地弯着；另一只手可帮助稳住。

steps.en: Close the fingers around the handle, keeping the thumb wrapped and the dumbbell in the palm.
steps.zh: 手指合拢握柄，拇指扣住，让哑铃留在掌中。

steps.en: Let the wrist lower gently into a small comfortable extension without rolling the handle into the fingertips.
steps.zh: 腕轻轻下放到小幅、舒服的伸展位置，不把把手滚到指尖。

steps.en: Breathe out and bend the wrist to bring the palm towards the forearm. Keep the elbow and forearm on the support.
steps.zh: 呼气，屈腕，让掌心靠向前臂；肘和前臂始终贴住支撑面。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly to the start. Use the free hand to take the dumbbell before changing sides.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢下放回起点；换边前用空闲手接住哑铃。

cues.en: Keep the movement small and centred at the wrist.
cues.zh: 幅度小一些，动作集中在腕部。

cues.en: Feel the front forearm, not a pinch in the wrist.
cues.zh: 用力感在前臂前面，不是腕部夹痛。

cues.en: Expect effort on the palm side of the forearm, not wrist pain.
cues.zh: 应感到前臂掌侧用力，不是腕痛。

mistakes.en: Lifting the forearm off the bench. Why: elbow movement replaces wrist flexion.
mistakes.zh: 前臂离开凳面。为什么：屈肘替代了屈腕。

mistakes.en: Letting the handle roll to the fingertips. Why: it changes the grip and increases the chance of losing the dumbbell.
mistakes.zh: 把手滚到指尖。为什么：握持方式改变，也更容易脱手。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: The model demonstrates the working joint only; support and single-hand equipment contact are shown by the sketch and described in the steps.
cautions.zh: 模型只演示练习侧关节；支撑和单手器械接触由示意图与步骤说明。

cautions.en: Use a light load and stop for wrist pain, numbness or tingling; do not treat it as a rehabilitation prescription.
cautions.zh: 用轻重量，腕痛、麻木或麻刺就停下；不要把它当作康复处方。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Sit beside a flat bench with a forearm supported palm down and the hand beyond the edge. Choose a very light dumbbell and keep its handle securely in the palm.
setup.zh: 坐在平板凳旁，前臂掌心向下有支撑，手伸出边缘。选很轻的哑铃，把手始终握在掌中。

steps.en: Plant the feet and rest the elbow and forearm on the pad, without pressing the edge into the wrist.
steps.zh: 双脚踩稳，肘和前臂放在软垫上，边缘不要压着腕。

steps.en: Grip the dumbbell palm down with the thumb wrapped. Let the hand lower into a small comfortable wrist bend.
steps.zh: 掌心向下握哑铃，拇指扣住；手轻轻下垂到小幅、舒服的屈腕位置。

steps.en: Breathe out and lift the back of the hand towards the forearm while keeping the forearm still.
steps.zh: 呼气，把手背抬向前臂，前臂保持不动。

steps.en: Stop before the wrist strains or moves towards the thumb or little-finger side. Keep the fingers securely closed.
steps.zh: 在腕出现吃力或偏向拇指、小指侧之前停下，手指始终握牢。

steps.en: Breathe in and lower slowly. Use the free hand to take the dumbbell before changing sides.
steps.zh: 吸气，慢慢下放；换边前用空闲手接住哑铃。

cues.en: Raise the hand, not the whole forearm.
cues.zh: 抬手，不抬整个前臂。

cues.en: Use a comfortable arc without forcing the top.
cues.zh: 走舒服的弧线，顶端不硬抬。

cues.en: Expect effort on the back of the forearm, not elbow pain.
cues.zh: 应感到前臂背侧用力，不是肘痛。

mistakes.en: Lifting the elbow to finish. Why: the weight moves without the intended wrist extension.
mistakes.zh: 最后抬肘帮忙。为什么：重量虽然上去了，却没有完成预定的伸腕。

mistakes.en: Opening the grip while the dumbbell hangs. Why: the weight can slip before the wrist muscles control it.
mistakes.zh: 哑铃悬着时松开手指。为什么：腕部还没控制好，重量就可能滑落。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: The model demonstrates the working joint only; support and single-hand equipment contact are shown by the sketch and described in the steps.
cautions.zh: 模型只演示练习侧关节；支撑和单手器械接触由示意图与步骤说明。

cautions.en: Stop for wrist or lateral elbow pain; this card does not diagnose or treat tendon problems.
cautions.zh: 腕或肘外侧疼痛就停下；本卡片不诊断或治疗肌腱问题。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Stand or sit comfortably without equipment. One hand supplies gentle resistance to the other forearm turning; this is a movement-learning drill, not a maximal-strength test.
setup.zh: 舒服地站或坐，无需器械。用一只手轻轻阻挡另一侧前臂转动；这是学习动作的练习，不是最大力量测试。

steps.en: Bend the working elbow beside the ribs with the forearm horizontal and thumb pointing up. Keep the wrist straight and fingers relaxed.
steps.zh: 练习侧肘在肋骨旁弯曲，前臂水平，拇指朝上；腕平直，手指放松。

steps.en: Cup the lower working forearm just above the wrist with the other hand. Use broad gentle contact; do not grip the wrist or pull the fingers.
steps.zh: 另一只手轻托练习侧前臂下端、腕关节上方。接触面要宽、力度轻，不抓腕关节，不拉手指。

steps.en: Turn the working forearm towards palm down while the other hand applies only enough opposing pressure to make the turn slow.
steps.zh: 练习侧前臂转向掌心朝下，另一只手只给足以让转动变慢的反向阻力。

steps.en: Stop at a comfortable partial turn, keeping the elbow in place and the shoulder facing forward. Continue breathing normally.
steps.zh: 转到舒服的部分幅度就停，肘不移位，肩仍朝前，保持正常呼吸。

steps.en: Release the resistance and return slowly to thumb up. Change sides and keep the same gentle control.
steps.zh: 撤去阻力，慢慢转回拇指朝上；换边时同样轻柔、受控。

cues.en: Turn the forearm while the wrist stays straight.
cues.zh: 前臂转，腕始终平直。

cues.en: Resist above the wrist and let the other hand follow the turn.
cues.zh: 在腕上方施阻力，另一只手跟随转动。

cues.en: Feel gentle effort near the upper inner forearm, not twisting at the wrist.
cues.zh: 前臂近端内侧轻轻用力，不是在腕部硬拧。

mistakes.en: Turning the whole arm at the shoulder. Why: the palm changes direction without demonstrating forearm pronation.
mistakes.zh: 在肩部转整个手臂。为什么：掌心方向变了，却没有展示前臂旋前。

mistakes.en: Twisting at the wrist or fingers. This loads small joints rather than opposing the forearm turn.
mistakes.zh: 在腕或手指上硬拧。这会加载小关节，不能正确阻挡前臂转动。

text.en: Choose resistance that lets the working joint move smoothly without borrowing motion from the trunk.
text.zh: 选择能让目标关节平稳运动的阻力，避免借躯干动作代偿。

text.en: Progress gradually when the movement is comfortable and repeatable, and rest enough to keep the same control.
text.zh: 动作舒服、每次都能稳定重复后，再逐步进阶；休息到能维持同样的控制。

cautions.en: The model shows forearm rotation; it does not constrain the assisting hand to remain in contact. Follow the sketch and steps for gentle resistance above the wrist.
cautions.zh: 模型展示前臂旋转，未约束辅助手保持接触；请按示意图与步骤，在腕上方轻轻施阻力。

cautions.en: Stop for elbow or wrist pain, tingling or numbness; keep resistance gentle.
cautions.zh: 肘痛、腕痛、麻刺或麻木就停下，阻力保持轻柔。

cautions.en: Learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise under adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。
